scroll_limit.upstream: Qdrant PR 10382 stops a scroll request without an explicit limit from bypassing strict-mode max_query_limit.
scroll_limit.maintained_contract: The packaged max_query_limit of 1000 now also bounds limitless scrolls; clients page at or below 1000 points per request.

collection_names.upstream: Qdrant PR 10242 rejects . and .. as collection names.
collection_names.maintained_contract: No maintained collection uses either name.

storage_recovery.upstream: Qdrant PR 10399 fixes a Gridstore panic on a new page after an unsafe shutdown and repairs preexisting failures; PR 10181 propagates mmap read errors.
storage_recovery.maintained_contract: Storage and recovery behavior are re-accepted only through the complete G3 migration, restore, corruption-rejection, retry, pressure, and restart matrix on the exact 1.19.1 binary.

turboquant.maintained_contract: TurboQuant stays disabled; no configuration enables it.

global_quotas.upstream: Qdrant PR 10035 adds the global quota API and deprecates strict-mode max_resident_memory_percent.
global_quotas.maintained_contract: Authenticated GET /quotas is authoritative; the deprecated strict-mode field is not preserved. The configured resident-memory value is under storage.quotas.

snapshot_recovery.upstream: Qdrant PR 9732 supports recovery of streamable-segment snapshots without a nested files directory.
snapshot_recovery.maintained_contract: The change requires separate G3 recovery acceptance. URL recovery remains disabled and snapshot storage remains local.

native_recipe_options.evidence: The exact PKGBUILD and regenerated .SRCINFO for each native lane contain both values.
native_recipe_options.buildinfo_global_option_disclosure: Each selected .BUILDINFO records builder-global debug and lto options from makepkg.conf. Those fields do not represent the recipe-effective overrides. The exact native recipes and .SRCINFO files declare !debug and !lto; each final output root contains one regular archive, no debug archive, and no usr/lib/debug payload. reconstruction.procedure: docs/maintainers/qdrant-migration-acceptance.md reconstruction procedure: empty per-lane SRCDEST and CARGO_HOME caches, a checksum-bound network-enabled prefetch, reflink copies of the verified caches into fresh final cache roots, path-neutral sorted manifests recorded before the final invocation, an incomplete-cache negative control in throwaway copies, and network-disabled final builds with CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true in fresh neutral package, build, and artifact roots.
reconstruction.prefetch_command: podman run --rm --userns=keep-id --pull=never --cgroups=split --network=pasta --env BUILDDIR=/build/build --env PKGDEST=/build/artifacts --env SRCDEST=/build/sources --env CARGO_HOME=/build/cargo --env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 --env SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=<lane-epoch> --volume <prefetch-package-root>:/build/package:Z --volume <prefetch-build-root>:/build/build:Z --volume <prefetch-artifact-root>:/build/artifacts:Z --volume <source-cache-root>:/build/sources:Z --volume <cargo-cache-root>:/build/cargo:Z localhost/arch-pkgs-qdrant-builder@sha256:876d4b2bfe03167c6d29f368def3050d4b1d16b3f89deead8379b61ccada10b0 zsh -fc 'cd /build/package && makepkg --verifysource && makepkg --nodeps -o'
reconstruction.final_command: podman run --rm --userns=keep-id --pull=never --cgroups=split --network=none --env CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true --env BUILDDIR=/build/build --env PKGDEST=/build/artifacts --env SRCDEST=/build/sources --env CARGO_HOME=/build/cargo --env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 --env SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=<lane-epoch> --volume <fresh-package-root>:/build/package:Z --volume <fresh-build-root>:/build/build:Z --volume <fresh-artifact-root>:/build/artifacts:Z --volume <final-source-cache-root>:/build/sources:Z --volume <final-cargo-cache-root>:/build/cargo:Z localhost/arch-pkgs-qdrant-builder@sha256:876d4b2bfe03167c6d29f368def3050d4b1d16b3f89deead8379b61ccada10b0 zsh -fc 'cd /build/package && makepkg --verifysource && makepkg --nodeps --cleanbuild --force'
reconstruction.tree_manifest_format: Sorted (C collation) newline-terminated lines. Directories: d, octal mode, relative path. Regular files: f, octal mode, size, SHA-256, relative path. Symbolic links: l, target, relative path. Fields are tab-separated; the digest is the SHA-256 of the listing.

procedure_deviations: Prefetch used --network=pasta because this podman rejects slirp4netns; prefetch outputs were discarded and are not candidates.
Every build used --userns=keep-id, as the accepted final3 builds did.
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 bounded Cargo parallelism for host memory; it does not change the recipe or the Cargo profile.
Each podman run used --cgroups=split inside a memory-capped transient user scope so the build's memory.peak could be recorded; this changes no build input.
qdrant-migration was not rebuilt: its recipe is unchanged, and the retained accepted archive is reused byte for byte.

common.root_policy: Each package copy, build directory, and artifact directory was a fresh generic root; only reflink copies of the verified prefetch caches were mounted as SRCDEST and CARGO_HOME.

payload_manifest.format: ASCII, newline-terminated, tab-separated records sorted as complete lines with LC_ALL=C. Directory records are d, mode without a leading zero, and relative path. This candidate has no symlink or special-file records.

verification.archive_entry_contract: Every archive member must use one canonical relative POSIX spelling, be unique after directory suffix normalization, carry numeric UID/GID 0 ownership, and be a 0644 regular file or 0755 directory. Links, special entries, absolute paths, traversal paths, aliases, raw duplicates, file-directory logical-path collisions, misleading owner names, and any extracted-tree link are rejected before payload inspection.
verification.payload_root_contract: Only the three recognized package metadata files, the Web UI tree, its required ancestors, and the exact license path are allowed. Hidden files and empty directories outside those roots are rejected.
verification.package_metadata_contract: Regular .PKGINFO, .BUILDINFO, and .MTREE files are mandatory. .PKGINFO must contain one exact reviewed identity and only the closed static-package field set; duplicate identities and transaction-affecting fields are rejected.
verification.contract_reason: Issue 28 G1 requires a clean build and inspection of payloads, ownership, modes, license, SBOM, package metadata, versions, and runtime bootstrap; it does not require byte-identical second-build reproduction.
verification.regressions: tests/test_qdrant_lane.py archive regressions passed against the bound verifier in this worktree

gate_disposition.standalone_authority: G0 and G1 acceptance records provenance and package evidence only. This record cannot authorize catalog publication; later gate evidence must be bound by a separate final acceptance index.

G0.basis: Pinned tag objects, signature status, verified commits, source and release-asset hashes, locked source identities, exact-version AUR reference metadata, .SRCINFO regeneration, divergences, release deltas, and the reconstruction procedure's cache, input, and output manifests are bound.

G1.basis: The exact three candidate archives are bound to frozen recipes, metadata, payloads, binaries where applicable, SBOMs, modes, ownership, reported versions, and absence of runtime bootstrap.

gate_disposition.later_gates: G2 runtime evidence, G3 migration and recovery, and G4 composed-service evidence are outside this record. The retained 1.17.1 tuple is a G3 input, not G3 acceptance.

privacy.path_neutrality: Repo-relative source paths, public URLs, stable container paths, role placeholders, and installed package paths only; no concrete host path is included.

recursive_strict_scan.rejects: Concrete temporary, home, privileged-account, checkout, cache, host, private-network, and operator-identity values

privacy.package_build_metadata: Exact BUILDINFO digests and stable in-container builddir and startdir values are bound; the installed-package list is not reproduced. No machine-local host path is reproduced.
